// Contrato em task.md. Motor puro: sem three, react, motion nem DOM.
import type { Vec2 } from './vec.ts'
import type { Vitals } from './stats.ts'
import type { AttackName, AttackProfile } from './attacks.ts'
import type { Room } from './arena.ts'

export type ActionKind = 'idle' | 'roll' | 'attack' | 'jump' | 'jumpAttack' | 'flask' | 'riposte' | 'stagger' | 'dead'

export type PlayerAction = {
  kind: ActionKind
  t: number
  attack: AttackName | null
  dir: Vec2
  hitIds: number[]
  healed: boolean
}

export type Player = {
  pos: Vec2
  y: number
  yaw: number
  vitals: Vitals
  flasks: number
  action: PlayerAction
  guarding: boolean
  sprinting: boolean
  lockOn: number | null
  guardCounter: number
}

export type PlayerInput = {
  move: Vec2
  sprint: boolean
  roll: boolean
  jump: boolean
  light: boolean
  heavy: boolean
  guard: boolean
  flask: boolean
}

export type PlayerContext = { targetPos: Vec2 | null; room: Room }

export const IDLE_ACTION: PlayerAction = { kind: 'idle', t: 0, attack: null, dir: { x: 0, z: 0 }, hitIds: [], healed: false }

export function createPlayer(pos: Vec2, yaw: number): Player {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: createPlayer(${pos.x},${yaw})`)
}

export function stepPlayer(player: Player, input: PlayerInput, dt: number, ctx: PlayerContext): Player {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: stepPlayer(${player.yaw},${input.sprint},${dt},${ctx.room.id})`)
}

export function isInvulnerable(player: Player): boolean {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: isInvulnerable(${player.action.kind})`)
}

export function activeAttack(player: Player): AttackProfile | null {
  throw new Error(`não implementado: activeAttack(${player.action.kind})`)
}
